title: Analysis of Cannabinoids in Bovine Urine Using Solid Phase Extraction & UPLC MS/MS
author: Geraldine Magnin
materials: Stock standards solutions in acetonitrile: From the commercially available solutions, prepare a stock solution containing the mixture of analytes at 10 mg/mL in ACN are prepared in acetonitrile and stored at -20 °C
Working standards for the preparation of QCs

steps.title: Prepare Cannabinoid Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a stock solution in a 4-mL glass vial for a final volume of 2000 µL by adding the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL of CBL at 500 µg/mL
Add 200 µL of each of the following at 100 µg/mL: THC-acid, THC-acid-glu, and THC-OH
Add 20 µL of each of the following at 1000 mg/mL (total volume 320 µL): CBC, CBCA, CBD, CDB-7-acid, CBDA, CBDV, CBDVA, CBG, CBGA, CBLA, CBN, 8-THC, 9-THC, THCA-A, THCP, and THCV
Add 1040 µL of ACN

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standards (IS) Mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare a mixture of internal standards at 10 µg/mL in ACN and store at -20 °C. The mixture includes 200 µL of each of the following at 100 µg/mL: THC-acid-glu-d3, THC-OH-d3, THC-acid-d9, 9-THC-d3, CBD-d3, CBC-d9, and THCA-A-d3.

steps.title: Prepare IS Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare an IS working solution at 50 ng/mL in acetonitrile:

substeps.instruction: In a 15-mL polypropylene tube, add 75 µL of IS mixture at 10 µg/mL
Add 14.9 mL of acetonitrile-0.1% formic acid

steps.title: Prepare Cannabinoid Working Standards
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh standard solutions in acetonitrile daily. Note: THC-glu (commercial solution 10 mg/mL) is added during working standard preparation.

substeps.instruction: 1000 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids working solution (10 µg/mL in ACN), 50 µL THC-glu (10 µg/mL), and 400 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
950 ng/mL: Mix 47.5 µL cannabinoids mix stock (10 µg/mL in ACN), 47.5 µL THC-glu stock (10 µg/mL in ACN), and 405 µL ACN
500 ng/mL: Mix 100 µL cannabinoids working solution (1000 ng/mL in ACN) and 100 µL solution at 1000 ng/mL in ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
475 ng/mL: Mix 100 µL cannabinoids working solution (950 ng/mL in ACN) and 100 µL ACN
250 ng/mL: Mix 100 µL cannabinoids mix (500 ng/mL in ACN) and 100 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
100 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids mix (1000 ng/mL in ACN) and 450 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
50 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids mix (500 ng/mL in ACN) and 450 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
47.5 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids working solution (950 ng/mL in ACN) and 450 µL ACN
25 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids mix (250 ng/mL in ACN) and 450 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
10 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids mix (100 ng/mL in ACN) and 450 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
5 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL cannabinoids mix (50 ng/mL in ACN) and 450 µL ACN in a 1.5-mL polypropylene tube
1 ng/mL: Mix 50 µL of mix (50 ng/mL) and 450 µL ACN

steps.title: Prepare Sample and Control Mixtures
steps.instruction: Prepare the following mixtures in 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tubes, vortexing where indicated, and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13,000 g:

substeps.instruction: Negative CTRL: 90 µL NEG CTRL urine, 210 µL ACN, and 400 µL 18W water (0.5% formic acid)
IS CTRL: 90 µL NEG CTRL urine, 10 µL ACN, 200 µL IS (50 ng/mL in ACN), vortex, and 400 µL 18W water (0.5% formic acid)
Calibration standards: 90 µL NEG CTRL urine, 10 µL calibration working standard in ACN, vortex, 200 µL IS (50 ng/mL in ACN), and 400 µL 18W water (0.5% formic acid)
QCs: 90 µL urine (sample or QC), 10 µL QC working standard in ACN, 200 µL IS (50 ng/mL in ACN), vortex, and 400 µL 18W water (0.5% formic acid)

steps.title: Perform Solid Phase Extraction (SPE)
steps.instruction: Process the diluted supernatants using an HLB mElution plate:

substeps.instruction: Fill out the plate template before adding solutions (NEG CTRL, IS CTRL, standards, QCs, or samples) to the wells
Stack the HLB mElution plate on top of a waste collection plate
Load each diluted supernatant into a well using positive pressure with nitrogen
Wash each well twice with 250 µL of MeOH-water (25:75)
Stack the HLB mElution plate on top of a clean collection plate
Elute cannabinoids with 2 x 25 µL aliquots of ACN-MeOH (90:10)
Add 50 µL of water with 0.2% formic acid to each well
Stack a cap mat on top of the plate and mix gently

steps.title: UPLC MS/MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze samples using a Waters Acquity H UPLC and TQ-S triple quadrupole mass spectrometer with MassLynx 4.2 software.

substeps.instruction: Use an Agilent Eclipse Plus C18 column (100 x 2.1 mm, 1.8 µm)
Set column temperature to 55 °C and autosampler compartment to 8 °C
Set flow rate to 0.5 mL/min and injection volume to 5 µL
Run for a total time of 10 minutes, diverting LC flow to waste from 0 to 0.70 min and from 8.00 to 10 min
Perform data acquisition via ESI in positive (ES+) and negative (ES-) modes using Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM)

steps.title: Data Processing and Validation
steps.instruction: Process the resulting chromatograms and validate against acceptance criteria:

substeps.instruction: Perform smoothing using the mean method (5 iterations, width 3) and integrate peaks using the Apex Track method
Calculate Signal-to-Noise (S/N) ratio using peak-to-peak values on unsmoothed data at 0.5, 1.0, and 2.5 ng/mL
Verify that retention time (RT) variation does not exceed 0.25% (averaged from 0.5 to 50 ng/mL standards)
Ensure Quantifier/Qualifier ratios in QCs do not exceed 20% of the average ratios in standards
Apply linear regression with a 1/x weighing factor (acceptance: squared coefficient of variation ≥ 0.99)
Verify calculated concentrations deviate ≤ 15% from theoretical value (20% for LOQ)
Determine LOD (S/N ≥ 3) and LOQ (S/N ≥ 10), ensuring intra-day and inter-day precision < 20% and QC accuracy at LLOQ is 80-120%
